question: Out of all the jobs opened in 2025, what percent ended up cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_cancelled FROM work_orders WHERE opened_at >= '2025-01-01' AND opened_at < '2026-01-01'

question: Of the money we've billed so far this year, not counting voided invoices, how much of it as a percentage is sitting overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 'overdue') / SUM(amount), 2) AS pct_overdue FROM invoices WHERE status <> 'void' AND issued_at >= '2026-01-01' AND issued_at < '2026-06-30'

question: What fraction of the jobs we finished last quarter were flagged urgent?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'urgent') / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_urgent FROM work_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND completed_at < '2026-04-01'

question: For each customer segment, what share of their work orders are repair calls?
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE w.job_type = 'repair') / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_repair FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

question: Looking at invoices issued in 2025 that have been paid, what percentage were paid on or before the due date?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid_at <= due_at) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_on_time FROM invoices WHERE status = 'paid' AND issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND issued_at < '2026-01-01'

question: Among our active accounts, what proportion are commercial customers?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'commercial') / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_commercial FROM customers WHERE is_active

question: Month by month this year, how many tickets came in versus how many got closed out?
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(m.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders w WHERE w.opened_at >= m.month AND w.opened_at < m.month + interval '1 month') AS opened, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders w WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= m.month AND w.completed_at < m.month + interval '1 month') AS completed FROM generate_series('2026-01-01'::timestamp, '2026-06-01'::timestamp, interval '1 month') AS m(month) ORDER BY m.month

question: For each month of last quarter, give me the number of invoices we sent out and the number that got paid.
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(m.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices i WHERE i.issued_at >= m.month AND i.issued_at < m.month + interval '1 month') AS issued, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices i WHERE i.paid_at >= m.month AND i.paid_at < m.month + interval '1 month') AS paid FROM generate_series('2026-01-01'::date, '2026-03-01'::date, interval '1 month') AS m(month) ORDER BY m.month

question: Quarter by quarter for 2025, how much did we bill (excluding voids) compared to how much cash actually came in?
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(q.quarter, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS quarter, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) FROM invoices i WHERE i.status <> 'void' AND i.issued_at >= q.quarter AND i.issued_at < q.quarter + interval '3 months') AS billed, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) FROM invoices i WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.paid_at >= q.quarter AND i.paid_at < q.quarter + interval '3 months') AS collected FROM generate_series('2025-01-01'::date, '2025-10-01'::date, interval '3 months') AS q(quarter) ORDER BY q.quarter

question: For each month from January through June of this year, how many visits were on the schedule and how many jobs were actually completed?
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(m.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders w WHERE w.scheduled_for >= m.month AND w.scheduled_for < m.month + interval '1 month') AS scheduled, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_orders w WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= m.month AND w.completed_at < m.month + interval '1 month') AS completed FROM generate_series('2026-01-01'::timestamp, '2026-06-01'::timestamp, interval '1 month') AS m(month) ORDER BY m.month

question: On average, how many days does it take us to close a job from the time it's opened, broken out by job type, for jobs finished in the last 12 months?
gold_sql: SELECT job_type, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM completed_at - opened_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days FROM work_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_at >= '2025-06-30' AND completed_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY job_type

question: How long do customers in each segment typically take to pay us? Average days from invoice date to payment, for invoices issued in 2025.
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(i.paid_at - i.issued_at), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'paid' AND i.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.segment

question: What did the parts we used on jobs completed last month cost us in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(x.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS parts_cost FROM work_order_parts x JOIN parts p ON p.id = x.part_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = x.work_order_id WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= '2026-05-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-06-01'

question: By part category, what's our markup in dollars (price minus cost, times units) on parts used for jobs completed so far this year?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(x.quantity * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) AS parts_margin FROM work_order_parts x JOIN parts p ON p.id = x.part_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = x.work_order_id WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.category

question: Are there any completed jobs that never got an invoice? List them.
gold_sql: SELECT w.id FROM work_orders w WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.work_order_id = w.id)

question: How many of our active customers haven't had a single job opened at any of their sites in the last 90 days?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_recent_jobs FROM customers c WHERE c.is_active AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sites s JOIN work_orders w ON w.site_id = s.id WHERE s.customer_id = c.id AND w.opened_at >= '2026-04-01')

question: In 2025, how many different months did each customer region have at least one urgent job that got cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', w.opened_at)) AS months FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE w.status = 'cancelled' AND w.priority = 'urgent' AND w.opened_at >= '2025-01-01' AND w.opened_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.region

question: Which five techs brought in the most labour dollars last month, figuring hours billed times their hourly rate?
gold_sql: SELECT t.id, t.full_name, SUM(w.labor_hours * t.hourly_rate) AS labor_value FROM work_orders w JOIN technicians t ON t.id = w.technician_id WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= '2026-05-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY t.id, t.full_name ORDER BY labor_value DESC, t.id LIMIT 5

question: Show me the ten oldest jobs still not done, with how many days each has been open.
gold_sql: SELECT id, status, ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp '2026-06-30 00:00:00' - opened_at) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS days_open FROM work_orders WHERE status IN ('open', 'scheduled', 'in_progress') ORDER BY opened_at, id LIMIT 10

question: Who were our five biggest customers by billed amount in 2025, leaving out voided invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(i.amount) AS billed FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE i.status <> 'void' AND i.issued_at >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY billed DESC, c.id LIMIT 5

question: What does the open backlog look like by priority? Count everything that's open, scheduled or in progress.
gold_sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS jobs FROM work_orders WHERE status IN ('open', 'scheduled', 'in_progress') GROUP BY priority

question: Top 10 cities by number of jobs opened last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT s.city, COUNT(*) AS jobs FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2026-01-01' AND w.opened_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY jobs DESC, s.city LIMIT 10

question: How many jobs of each type did we open in May?
gold_sql: SELECT job_type, COUNT(*) AS jobs FROM work_orders WHERE opened_at >= '2026-05-01' AND opened_at < '2026-06-01' GROUP BY job_type

question: Which ten parts have we gone through the most of this year, by units, on jobs opened since January?
gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(x.quantity) AS units FROM work_order_parts x JOIN parts p ON p.id = x.part_id JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = x.work_order_id WHERE w.opened_at >= '2026-01-01' AND w.opened_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC, p.id LIMIT 10

question: Which technicians charge an hourly rate above the company-wide average?
gold_sql: SELECT id, full_name, hourly_rate FROM technicians WHERE hourly_rate > (SELECT AVG(hourly_rate) FROM technicians)

question: How much is overdue right now in each customer region?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(i.amount) AS overdue_amount FROM invoices i JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = i.work_order_id JOIN sites s ON s.id = w.site_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id WHERE i.status = 'overdue' GROUP BY c.region

question: How many new accounts did we sign each month in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_accounts FROM customers WHERE created_at >= '2025-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Who are the five busiest techs over the last 90 days, by jobs completed?
gold_sql: SELECT t.id, t.full_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_jobs FROM work_orders w JOIN technicians t ON t.id = w.technician_id WHERE w.status = 'completed' AND w.completed_at >= '2026-04-01' AND w.completed_at < '2026-06-30' GROUP BY t.id, t.full_name ORDER BY completed_jobs DESC, t.id LIMIT 5
